notes: Partition checks out: all seven s-ids and all twelve t-ids used exactly once, every head a member of its array.

s003 τετυφωμένοι → puffed up is right as one unit headed on puffed: up is the phrasal verb's own particle, as rule 34 treats off in afar off, and rule 17's support-verb clause does not apply because puffed is itself the lexical word.
s005/s006 are correctly split rather than joined — the ASV writes a separate English word for each of μᾶλλον and ἤ, so rule 2 governs and neither rule 39 nor rule 45 is in question.

Heads on lovers for both φιλήδονοι and φιλόθεοι are defensible and consistently taken. Rule 66's generic-completion test does not decide these, since neither lovers nor pleasure/God is an empty completion — both elements of the compound are glossed. Rule 17's of + noun clause is not the contrast either: it covers a source noun whose whole English is of + noun (τῆς εἰρήνης → of peace), not a compound whose first element is separately realized. Heading on pleasure and God remains defensible, but the accepted note states its reading and rule 24 keeps the two compounds analysed alike.
